teacher.concurrency_source: default of the live teacher client
teacher.source: recorded live labelling calls on the test split (cache hits and retried attempts excluded)
teacher.list_price_note: the recorded token counts at the pricing snapshot's list price, without the provider's prompt cache

student.note: in-process generation latency from `taskdistill eval` (flagged: not end-to-end through `serve`; run `taskdistill bench` against `serve --threshold 0` for the measured figure)
student.cost_basis: local energy estimate over the mean student latency

cascade.source: composed per test request: student latency, plus the recorded teacher latency when escalated
cascade.cost_basis: student energy for every request plus the recorded teacher cost of escalated requests
